limits: One retained rival, four canonical demonstrations fitted before one canonical query and one retained witness; 12 protected native evaluations. Twelve ordinary generated draws checked in independent Python, not a repeated 6000-draw census or a full battery. Production margin=1 and guarded fallback exclude edge-touching ordinary scenes.

programs.canonical:
(rule!
  (let* ((cells (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0)))))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
    (if bb
        (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))
        (empty-grid 1 1 0))))
programs.erase_border_then_crop:
(rule!
  (let* ((stripped (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
                    (lambda (r c) (if (or (= r 0) (= c 0)
                       (= r (- (rows g) 1)) (= c (- (cols g) 1))) 0 (at g r c)))))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells (filter-cells stripped (lambda (r c v) (!= v 0))))))
    (if bb (subgrid stripped (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))
        (empty-grid 1 1 0))))
